data.narrative:
CORE POWER is a Growth-stage nuclear energy company founded by Mikal Bøe that has raised $100M+. The valuation universe comprises 11 total comparable companies across Nuclear Energy—3 publicly traded (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private firms including Helion, Oklo, Valar Atomics, X-Energy, and Nano Nuclear Energy.

Only one valuation method proved applicable. Stage-Progression analysis uses the $100M total raised as a proxy base value and applies a 1.2x step-up multiplier typical for Growth-stage advancement, yielding $120M. Peer-Median triangulation could not be applied; although 6 same-sector peers exist, none met minimum thresholds (≥3 datapoints) when filtered by stage, adjacency, or valuation tier, making an all-sector median unreliable and uninformative.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $102M–$138M, centered on $120M. This narrow range reflects reliance on a single method and underscores material uncertainty around comparable scaling in a sector where stage-to-stage progression patterns remain underdeveloped. The primary constraint is sparse comparable data at CORE POWER's specific stage and capital tier. Refinement would require either additional private-market transaction data or explicit peer multiples (revenue, development milestones) from the public nuclear cohort.
